title: 第12章  她要嫁人了，新郎不是你！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
花轿轻晃。
外面是鼎沸的人声和喜庆的乐曲。
轿内，却是一片安静的红。
李青鸾端坐着，双手紧张地绞着衣角，心脏不争气地狂跳。
她能清晰地感受到，那个男人的气息，似乎还残留在自己的身上。
刚才被他背出来的那一小段路，是她这辈子，第一次与一个男子有如此亲密的接触。
他的后背很宽阔，很温暖。
他的脚步很稳，没有一丝一毫的晃动。
他身上的味道……也很好闻。
和传闻中那个终日厮混于烟花柳巷的纨绔子弟，完全不一样。
鬼使神差地，一个大胆的念头冒了出来。
她想看看他。
看看这个即将成为自己夫君的男人，此刻是什么样子。
这个念头一生出来，便再也无法遏制。
她的手，微微颤抖着，小心翼翼地，掀起了红盖头的一角。
从那狭小的缝隙中，她看到了外面的景象。
看到了街道两旁热闹的人群。
也看到了……那个骑在白色龙马上的挺拔背影。
他就在花轿的前方，一身红衣，身姿如松。
在喧闹的人群和盛大的仪仗中，竟有一种说不出的从容与镇定。

就在这时，仿佛心有感应一般。
马背上的赵辰安，忽然回过了头。
四目相对，哪怕隔着轿帘的缝隙，赵辰安也捕捉到了那瞬间的惊慌。
随即，那片红色便急急地落了下去，严丝合缝。
赵辰安失笑，勒住缰绳，放慢了龙马的脚步，与花轿并行。
他没有再回头。
但那份若有似无的馨香，和那道慌乱的倩影，却在他心头萦绕不散。
十六皇子府。
相比于车骑将军府的雄浑大气，这座府邸要显得小巧精致许多。
但今日，这里却是整个皇城最热闹的地方。
府门大开，红毯从门口一直铺到了内院，两旁的红灯笼高高挂起，即便是在白日，也透着一股浓浓的喜气。
宾客往来，络绎不绝。
虽然碍于赵辰安往日的名声和无法修行的体质，那些真正位高权重的王公大臣并未亲至。
但各家派来的管事和送上的贺礼，也足以将半个院子堆满。
其余的皇子和公主们，也都心照不宣地派人送来了贺礼。
对此，赵辰安早已习惯，也乐得清静。
他换下那身繁复的喜袍，只着一件大红色的便服，端着酒杯，在宾客间穿梭答谢。
他举止得体，谈笑风生，丝毫没有传闻中的纨绔与不堪，反倒让不少初次见他的宾客暗暗称奇。
酒过三巡，气氛正酣。
“三皇子殿下到！”

一声高亢的通报，像是平地惊雷，瞬间让喧闹的庭院安静了下来。
众人循声望去。
只见府门口，一道身影踉跄着闯了进来。
来人同样穿着一身锦袍，只是那料子早已皱得不成样子。
发冠也歪斜了，整个人看起来狼狈不堪，满身酒气。
正是三皇子，赵辰宇。
他不是应该在府中禁足吗？
众人心中都冒出这个念头。
赵辰安微微眯起眼睛，算算日子，三哥的禁足，好像就是今天结束。
还真是第一时间就冲过来了。
看着庭院中满目的红色，看着那个正在对宾客言笑晏晏的赵辰安，赵辰宇只觉得一股血气直冲头顶。
一切都完了。
他心心念念了那么多年的女人，终究还是嫁给了别人。
嫁给了他这个一无是处的废物弟弟！
嫉妒、不甘、愤怒……无数种情绪在他胸中翻腾，烧得他双目赤红。
“十六弟，恭喜啊！”
赵辰宇的声音沙哑，带着一股压抑的疯狂。
他推开挡在身前的人，一步步朝着赵辰安走去。
周围的宾客纷纷避让，生怕被这个明显不对劲的三皇子波及。
赵辰安放下酒杯，脸上的笑容不变，迎了上去。

“三哥，你能来，弟弟很高兴。”
“高兴？”赵辰宇走到他面前，死死地盯着他：
“你当然高兴！抱得美人归，你怎么能不高兴！”
“三哥，你喝多了。”
赵辰安的语气依旧平淡。
他不想在这种场合刺激这个可怜的兄长。
然而，他的平静，在赵辰宇看来，却是赤裸裸的炫耀和嘲讽。
“我没喝多！我清醒得很！”
赵辰宇突然伸出双手，癫狂地抓住赵辰安的肩膀，用力摇晃。
“赵辰安！你凭什么！你一个连苦海都开辟不了的废物，凭什么能娶青鸾！”
“你告诉我，凭什么！”
他的嘶吼，让整个庭院落针可闻。
赵辰安没有反抗，任由他摇晃着，只是静静地看着他。
“三哥，这桩婚事，是父皇赐下的。”
“父皇？”
听到这两个字，赵辰宇像是被抽走了所有力气，动作一滞。
他松开赵辰安，身体晃了晃，脸上露出一抹惨笑。
是啊，是父皇。
在这大周王朝，谁敢违抗他的意志？
赵辰安看着他失魂落魄的样子，正准备开口劝慰几句。

不料，赵辰宇却猛地凑了上来，几乎是贴着他的耳朵，用只有两人才能听到的声音，阴狠地说道：
“十六弟，这不怪你……真的，皇兄不怪你。”
他的声音很轻，却带着一股彻骨的寒意。
“要怪，就怪父皇！都是他的错！是他毁了我的一切！”
“他会后悔的……我保证，他一定会后悔的！”
说罢，他猛地推开赵辰安，转身便走。
他一边走，一边疯疯癫癫地笑着，那笑声里，充满了绝望与疯狂。
“哈哈哈哈……父皇……好一个父皇！”
他就这么在所有人的注视下，踉踉跄跄地消失在了府门外。
庭院里，死一般的寂静。
所有人都被这突如其来的一幕给惊呆了。
赵辰安站在原地，整理了一下被抓皱的衣领，若有所思地看着赵辰宇离去的方向。
这事，恐怕没那么简单。
如果换成自己，心爱的女人嫁给了别人，还是自己的亲弟弟，说不定也会做出什么极端的事情来。
不过，这个念头只是一闪而过。
他很快便无所谓地笑了笑。
既然这婚事是父皇一手安排的，那父皇肯定就算到了一切可能发生的变数。
那位高坐龙椅之上的父亲，可不是什么和善之辈。
当年，他能从上百位继承人之中一路浴血搏杀。
最终登上皇位。

心智与手段，又岂是常人能够揣度的？
这些年，不过是天下太平，朝堂稳固，才让他收敛了几分锋芒而已。
一个失意的皇子，还翻不起什么浪来。
夜幕降临，喧闹了一天的皇子府，终于安静了下来。
红烛高照，将庭院映得一片通红。
赵辰安独自站在院中，任由晚风吹拂着发烫的脸颊。
他抬头，望向远处那间灯火通明的房间。
那里，是他的婚房。
深吸一口气，将杯中残酒一饮而尽。
赵辰安迈开脚步，朝着那片温暖的灯光走去。
穿过寂静的庭院，走过长长的回廊。
他停在了那扇紧闭的雕花木门前。
门内，烛影摇红。
赵辰安抬起手，轻轻地推在了门板上。
content_en:
The sedan chair swayed slightly.
There was a buzz of people and festive music outside.
Inside the sedan, it was a quiet red.
Li Qingluan sat upright, nervously twisting the corners of his clothes with his hands, and his heart was beating wildly.
She could clearly feel that the man's breath seemed to still remain on her body.
The short distance he carried just now was the first time in her life that she had such close contact with a man.
His back was broad and warm.
His steps were steady, without any sway.
He smells...very good too.
He is completely different from the rumored playboy who hangs out in Fireworks Willow Lane all day long.
Out of nowhere, a bold idea came to me.
She wanted to see him.
Look at what the man who is about to become her husband looks like now.
Once this idea comes up, it can no longer be contained.
Her hands were trembling slightly as she carefully lifted up a corner of the red hijab.
From the narrow gap, she saw the scene outside.
I saw the lively crowds on both sides of the street.
I also saw...the tall figure riding on the white dragon horse.
He was right in front of the sedan chair, dressed in red and with a posture like a pine tree.
Amid the noisy crowds and grand ceremony, there was an indescribable calmness and calmness.
At this moment, it was as if there was a feeling in my heart.
Zhao Chenan, who was on horseback, suddenly turned his head.
Their eyes met, and even through the gap in the sedan curtain, Zhao Chenan captured the panic in that moment.
Immediately, the piece of red fell down quickly, fitting tightly.
Zhao Chenan laughed, reined in the reins, slowed down the pace of the dragon and horse, and walked side by side with the sedan chair.
He didn't look back.
But the vague fragrance and the panicked figure lingered in his heart.
The Sixteenth Prince's Mansion.
Compared to the grandeur of the Cavalry General's Mansion, this mansion appears much smaller and more delicate.
But today, this is the busiest place in the entire imperial city.
The door of the mansion is wide open, a red carpet is spread from the door to the inner courtyard, and red lanterns are hung high on both sides. Even in the daytime, there is a strong sense of joy.
Guests come and go in an endless stream.
Although due to Zhao Chenan's past reputation and inability to cultivate, those truly high-ranking princes and ministers did not come in person.
But the stewards sent by each family and the congratulatory gifts were enough to fill half the yard.
The other princes and princesses also sent congratulatory gifts tacitly.
Zhao Chenan has long been accustomed to this and is happy to be quiet.
He changed out of his complicated wedding robe and wore only a bright red casual suit. He held a wine glass and walked among the guests to thank them.
He behaved well, talked and laughed happily, and was not at all dandy or unworthy as rumored. On the contrary, many guests who met him for the first time were secretly amazed.
After three drinks, the atmosphere was lively.
"His Royal Highness the Third Prince has arrived!"
A high-pitched announcement, like thunder on the ground, instantly silenced the noisy courtyard.
Everyone followed the sound.
I saw a figure staggering in at the door of the house.
The visitor was also wearing a brocade robe, but the material was already wrinkled.
The hair crown was also crooked, and the whole person looked embarrassed and smelled of alcohol.
It was the third prince, Zhao Chenyu.
Shouldn't he be grounded in the house?
This thought came to everyone's mind.
Zhao Chenan narrowed his eyes slightly and counted the days. The third brother's grounding seemed to end today.
He really rushed over immediately.
Looking at the red color in the courtyard and looking at Zhao Chenan who was smiling and talking to the guests, Zhao Chenyu felt a blood rush to his head.
All is lost.
The woman he had been thinking about for so many years finally married someone else.
Marrying his good-for-nothing good-for-nothing younger brother!
Jealousy, unwillingness, anger... countless emotions surged in his chest, burning his eyes red.
"Sixteenth brother,Congratulations! "
Zhao Chenyu's voice was hoarse, with a suppressed madness.
He pushed away the person in front of him and walked towards Zhao Chenan step by step.
The surrounding guests all moved out of the way, for fear of being affected by the Third Prince who was obviously not right.
Zhao Chenan put down his wine glass, the smile on his face remained unchanged, and he went to greet him.
"Third brother, I'm very happy that you can come. "
"Happy? "Zhao Chenyu walked up to him and stared at him:
"Of course you are happy! How can you not be happy to have a beautiful woman in your arms? "
"Third brother, you drank too much. "
Zhao Chenan's tone was still calm.
He didn't want to offend his poor brother on this occasion.
However, in Zhao Chenyu's view, his calmness was naked showing off and ridicule.
“I didn’t drink too much! I'm wide awake! "
Zhao Chenyu suddenly stretched out his hands, grabbed Zhao Chenan's shoulders frantically, and shook him hard.
"Zhao Chenan! Why are you! You, a loser who can't even open up the sea of ​​suffering, why can you marry Qingluan! "
"Tell me why! "
His roar was heard throughout the courtyard.
Zhao Chenan didn't resist, let him shake, and just looked at him quietly.
“Third brother, this marriage was granted by my father. "
"Father? "
Upon hearing these two words, Zhao Chenyu seemed to have all his strength taken away, and his movements stagnated.
He let go of Zhao Chenan, his body swayed, and a sad smile appeared on his face.
Yes, it’s my father.
In this great Zhou Dynasty, who dares to defy his will?
Zhao Chenan looked at his devastated look and was about to say a few words of comfort.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Chenyu suddenly came closer, almost close to his ear, and said viciously in a voice that only the two of them could hear:
"Sixteenth Brother, I don't blame you...Really, Brother Huang doesn't blame you. "
His voice was very soft, but it carried a chill to the bone.
“If you want to blame it, blame it on Father! It's all his fault! He ruined everything for me! "
"He will regret it...I promise, he will regret it! "
After saying that, he pushed Zhao Chenan away violently, turned around and left.
As he walked, he laughed crazily, and his laughter was full of despair and madness.
"Hahahaha...Father...what a father! "
Under everyone's gaze, he staggered and disappeared outside the mansion.
In the courtyard, there was deathly silence.
Everyone was stunned by this sudden scene.
Zhao Chenan stood there, straightened his wrinkled collar, and looked thoughtfully at the direction Zhao Chenyu was leaving.
I'm afraid this matter is not that simple.
If it were him, and the woman he loved married someone else, or his biological brother, he might do something extreme.
However, this thought only passed by for a moment.
He quickly smiled nonchalantly.
Since this marriage was arranged by my father, he must have considered all possible variables.
The father sitting high on the throne is not a kind person.
Back then, he was able to fight his way through hundreds of heirs in a bloody battle.
Finally ascended to the throne.
How can the mind and means be inferred by ordinary people?
In recent years, it was only the peace in the world and the stability of the court that allowed him to temper his edge a little.
A frustrated prince cannot afford to make trouble.
As night fell, the Prince's Mansion, which had been noisy all day, finally became quiet.
The red candles shone brightly, making the courtyard bright red.
Zhao Chenan stood alone in the courtyard, letting the evening wind blow his hot cheeks.
He raised his head and looked toward the brightly lit room in the distance.
There is his wedding room.
Take a deep breath and drink the remaining wine in the glass.
Zhao Chenan stepped forward and walked towards the warm light.
Pass through the silent courtyard and walk through the long corridor.
He stopped in front of the closed carved wooden door.
Inside the door, the candle shadow flickers red.
Zhao Chenan raised his hand and gently pushedOn the door panel.
